blocks.text: Hormones kimiyai groups mein bate hain jo tay karte hain ke woh cell membrane paar kar sakte hain ya nahi.

blocks.caption: Hormones ke kimiyai groups
rows: amino acids ki zanjeerein; pani mein hal
nahi: cell ki sateh ke receptors se judte
insulin (pancreas: glucose kam); glucagon (pancreas: glucose zyada); growth hormone (anterior pituitary: nashonuma); oxytocin (hypothalamus, posterior pituitary chhorta: paidaish mein sukarna)
carbohydrate group wala protein; bara, polar
TSH (anterior pituitary: thyroid se thyroxine banwata); FSH (sperm banana, anday ki nashonuma); LH (ovulation; testosterone ka ifraz)
aik amino acid, aam taur par tyrosine ya tryptophan, se bane chhote molecules
munhasir: epinephrine aur norepinephrine nahi, thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine kar sakte
epinephrine (adrenal medulla: lado ya bhago); norepinephrine (adrenal medulla: blood pressure, chaukasi); thyroxine T4 (thyroid: metabolism ki raftar); T3 (thyroid: darja-e-hararat aur dharkan)

cortisol (adrenal cortex: metabolism, tanao); aldosterone (adrenal cortex: namak aur pani); testosterone (testes: mardana tissues aur khasusiyat); estrogen aur progesterone (ovaries: zanana nizam aur cycle)

blocks.text: Endocrine gland kisi khaas muharrik par apna hormone chhorta hai. Khoon hormone ko tamam cells tak le jata hai, magar sirf target cells jawab dete hain jin par us khaas hormone se judne wale receptors hote hain. Judna aise waqiat shuru karta hai jo cell ko badalte hain. Receptors cell membrane, cytoplasm ya nucleus mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Hormones aur neurotransmitters
blocks.text: Dono kimiyai paighambar hain, magar hormones endocrine system aur neurotransmitters nervous system ka hissa hain. Hormones aam taur par der se asar karte aur un ke asraat der tak rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Insulin aur testosterone ke receptors kahan hote hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Insulin, pani mein hal protein, membrane paar nahi kar sakta, is liye us ke receptors cell ki sateh par hain. Testosterone, charbi mein hal steroid, membrane paar karta hai, is liye us ke receptors cell ke andar hain.

items: Protein/peptide aur glycoprotein hormones: sateh ke receptors. Amino acid derivatives: kuch paar (T3, T4), kuch nahi (epinephrine). Steroids (cholesterol se): paar kar ke nucleus par asar.
